name: Intercity, HSR & Express Metro Trains
author: danielloong714
description:
Adds three new trains, each with its own **dedicated track type**:

- **Express Metro** — 110 km/h skip-stop metro service (220 pax/car, 2-8 cars)
- **Intercity Train** — 180 km/h fast regional rail (140 pax/car, 4-14 cars)
- **HSR** — 324 km/h high-speed rail (8-16 cars, trains up to 400 m)

All stats calibrated against the built-in Subway Builder v1.6.0 fleet for balanced gameplay.
